_comment: Single source of truth for what the site may claim. States: active, released, development (built and being tested, not available to download or open), planned, deferred. A 'released' platform must have a url; the build refuses to render a launch/download button otherwise.

android.name: Android
android.summary: In invite-only closed testing on Google Play. Not yet publicly available.

linux.name: Linux desktop
linux.summary: Nozzle It All for Desktop on Linux is built and being tested. Not yet available to download.

web.name: Web app
web.summary: Nozzle It All Web, the full app in your browser, is built and being tested. Not yet available to open.

windows.name: Windows desktop
windows.summary: Planned after Linux. The Desktop app is being built so the same app can be packaged for Windows.
